description: Creates a NEW empty enrichment sheet owned by the authenticated user and returns its sheetId. mode 'people' is for contacts and 'company' for organizations. A sheet the user already has with the same name and mode is returned instead of creating a duplicate. Sheets can be created here, not only in the dashboard.

mode.description: 'people' for contact sheets, 'company' for organization sheets.

name.description: Sheet name exactly as the user should see it in the dashboard.

name: create_sheet
title: Criar planilha
